sql: SELECT SUM(l.unit_price * l.quantity) AS revenue FROM public.invoice_line AS l JOIN public.track AS t ON l.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.album AS a ON t.album_id = a.album_id JOIN public.artist AS r ON a.artist_id = r.artist_id WHERE r.name = 'Led Zeppelin'
derivation: same SQL business logic, only physical schema remapped
